needs_human.note: The migration transaction uses a raw DBAPI connection with isolation_level=None and BEGIN IMMEDIATE, not the begin_nested() SAVEPOINT on its own connection that the touch-point text describes. The code is authoritative, so this is noted only to say where to review I2.; repair_unkeyed_rows reads the NULL id list on one connection and repairs on later transactions. A row re-keyed concurrently in between is not expected at startup.
